protocol.status: Retrospective research: all historical seasons have already been inspected. Future prospective forecasts provide the next untouched test.
protocol.distributionFit: Conditional logistic margin scale selected by earlier out-of-sample margin density loss on 4..15 in 0.25 steps; location=scale*logit(p). This was revised after the first retrospective interval-coverage audit showed narrow ranges. All test seasons remain reused research, not untouched validation.
protocol.promotionGate: Brier and log loss improve against the previous baseline on paired games; paired day-cluster bootstrap 95% upper Brier difference is below zero; latest-season log loss does not worsen. Otherwise retain as research.
protocol.travelLimitation: Road-trip and previous-away sequence are proxies. No geographic distance or time-zone travel data is present.
protocol.playerLeaguePrior: Frozen at each season start from earlier eligible appearances, matching the deployed fitted-prior approach.
protocol.playerEvaluation: Conditional on an observed appearance; not pregame roster availability or bookmaker prop accuracy. Settings chosen only on earlier seasons.

promotion.gate: Brier and log loss improve against the previous baseline on paired games; paired day-cluster bootstrap 95% upper Brier difference is below zero; latest-season log loss does not worsen. Otherwise retain as research.

limitations: Reused historical research seasons; no independently untouched historical holdout remains. Game classifier and total regression use lagged final scores and schedule features, with a 24-hour result embargo. Current injury/lineup adjustments remain assumptions. Player-prop probabilities and betting ROI are not validated.
